title: Best Summer Fabrics for Staying Cool Without Overheating
description: Discover the best summer fabrics for staying cool and comfortable. Learn which natural and plant-based fabrics breathe best and which to avoid in peak heat.
lede: If you've ever stepped outside in a polyester shirt on a humid day and immediately regretted it, you already understand why fabric choice matters in summer. The best summer fabrics for staying cool aren't about technology or performance claims — they're mostly about going back to what plants have been offering for thousands of years.
